keys.effect: Internal render resolution scaling percentage for DLSS/FSR/XeSS upscaling (50%=Performance, 59%=Balanced, 67%=Quality, AA=DLAA Native).
keys.notes: At 5120x1440, 67% (Quality) renders internally at 3430x965 before upscaling, maintaining high framerates above 60 FPS+.

keys.effect: Shadow map resolution and cascade quality.
